```lean
structure MeansState where

  pure  : Bool

def sambhava (s : MeansState) : Bool := s.ready
def sakta (s : MeansState) : Bool := s.ready && s.pure

def allMeansStates : List MeansState :=
  [ { ready := true,  pure := true },
    { ready := true,  pure := false },
    { ready := false, pure := true },
    { ready := false, pure := false } ]

def purityLoadBearing : MeansState := { ready := true, pure := false }

def saktaContainedInSambhava : Prop :=
  ∀ s : MeansState, sakta s → sambhava s

def sambhavaCount : Nat :=
  allMeansStates.filter (fun s => sambhava s).length

def anava : Bool :=
  UNFORMULABLE -- requires a repetition count n, which is not expressible with {ready, pure}
```
